focus: Bitnomial XRP collateral and Ripple Prime clearing-member connection; CFTC Letter 26-05 conditional FCM path; ETF completeness; main workflow audit; exact-head ledger validator failure and append-only schema correction.

findings.claim: Bitnomial Clearinghouse, a CFTC-registered DCO, lists XRP as accepted collateral with a 40% haircut and $15M notional limit. The same page lists XRP product maintenance-margin entries at 17%; the haircut and maintenance margin are distinct controls. Actual utilization is undisclosed.
Bitnomial's XRUH XRP USD Hecto futures are 100 XRP per contract, USD-margined, 23/5 and deliverable. This is a physical/deliverable futures product, not the same as its cash-settled perpetual.

Bitnomial's PXRPUS XRP perpetual is 24/7, cash-settled to the CF XRP Mid-Price Spot Rate, with a 1 XRP minimum contract and funding calculated every eight hours. Positive funding means longs pay shorts.

CFTC Staff Letter 26-05 was issued in response to Coinbase Financial Markets' request. It provides a conditional staff no-action pathway for FCMs relying on it to account for non-security digital assets accepted by a registered DCO, subject to the DCO's valuation/haircuts and segregation, risk and reporting conditions. It is not a blanket Commission rule or proof of any firm's actual use.

The December 2025 CFTC release names BTC, ETH and USDC for the initial three-month phase of the FCM pilot. Letter 26-05's DCO-accepted-asset pathway is broader in structure; the initial phase is measured from each FCM's commencement of reliance. Do not claim XRP is categorically excluded from all CFTC collateral frameworks.

Ripple closed its Hidden Road acquisition in October 2025 and rebranded it Ripple Prime. Ripple says RLUSD is used as collateral for some prime-brokerage products and some derivatives customers hold RLUSD balances. This is RLUSD use, not proof of XRP collateral utilization.

Ripple Prime announced US institutional OTC spot execution across assets including XRP and RLUSD and cross-margining of OTC spot holdings with OTC swaps and CME futures/options. These are described capabilities, not measured client balances or realized volumes.

Bitnomial's clearing-member list includes Hidden Road Partners CIV US LLC. Ripple states Hidden Road became Ripple Prime after the acquisition. This establishes a structural Ripple-group/Bitnomial clearing-member connection, not actual XRP collateral deposits.

The combination of Ripple ownership of Ripple Prime, the listed Hidden Road Partners CIV US LLC clearing-member relationship at Bitnomial, Bitnomial's XRP collateral acceptance, and the conditional FCM framework creates a plausible institutional path for XRP collateral use. Actual FCM reliance, XRP deposits, customer balances and utilization remain unknown.

Coinbase Financial Markets initiated the no-action request underlying Letter 26-05, but no evidence here establishes that Coinbase Financial Markets has a clearing-member relationship with Bitnomial or has accepted XRP collateral.

CryptoETF.today displays +$2.9M XRP ETF flow for October 29 but labels the total partial at 1 of 5 funds reported; only Bitwise had reported and four funds remained pending. This is not a completed daily total.

XRP Insights reports -2,958,545 XRP settled across October 26–28 and 1,190,251,285 XRP held on October 28; October 29 is provisional. The fund population includes six US spot funds plus BITW and excludes GXRP flows while correcting a data gap.

Main SHA ec52a66 is reported protected, but the classic branch-protection readback has empty required status-check contexts and checks. Effective rulesets and bypass behavior remain unverified. The auto-merge workflow is manual and read-only; the merge queue remains manual but mutation-capable; cross-analysis is scheduled and writes generated knowledge files to main.

PR #1353's dedicated validator passed 15 tests and Python compilation on exact head 66b416; its fail-closed gate passed on that head. This is not full repository CI and does not verify subsequent ledger appends.

The validator code was not changed; corrected shards are being prepared and invalid originals retained unreferenced.
